title: Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque and mapped Mahligai barge/footbridge:large gold onion dome and white slotted drum,tall square open-belfry minaret,white flat wings,pointed porticos and small gold-capped chattris;upturned barge hull,two steep green side roofs,three-tier central open pavilion and curved footbridge. Exact raw footprint,lagoon hole,monument point and bridge control retained. Heights beyond the qualified52m tip,partitions,bay counts,ornament,current finishes and exact ground/water joins remain estimated. Six shared graphs,seven merged roles,four browser levels.
